sentences: Equilibrium computation seeks prices or strategies at which the relevant participants have no profitable unilateral change.
The saved source asks for polynomial-time algorithms across monotone utility classes.
Monotonicity says that receiving more of a desirable resource does not decrease utility, but leaves many different preference shapes possible.
A broad algorithmic result would clarify which additional utility properties are truly needed for tractable equilibrium.
The title does not identify the market model, utility representation, or equilibrium accuracy, so it cannot be read as a claim about every monotone preference in every game.
